name: @superatom/fast-router
description: Per-project fast search/classification worker. Connects to each project's DO hub as role 'fast-router' and answers as-you-type suggestions in milliseconds. Node/TypeScript only — no Python runtime.

pnpm.comment: onnxruntime-node MUST resolve to ONE version across the whole tree. GLiNER (via transformers 3.8.1) needs 1.21.0 and the MiniLM embedder (transformers 4.2.0) pulls 1.24.3; on Linux the two native .so files collide on symbol version VERS_1.21.0 and the worker crash-loops. Pin everything to GLiNER's 1.21.0 (embeddings work fine on it).
